searchText: If anybody has Geth 1.10.5 dev release running, could they provide a JSON output of fee_history API for any block on Ropsten? Thank you! For a mining pool, what kind of things we would need to change to support EIP-1559? I don't think there's anything special about this particular hard fork, so just upgrading your respective clients should do. So the full transaction fees are still awarded to miners? o.O Greetings everyone, I'm interested to know what implications will the EIP-1559 update have on my currently deployed DApp on the mainnet? Would any changes be required on the current UI? Would be grateful if anyone could help me on this Thanks in advance The bare minimum is to just upgrade your clients to a London fork supporting version. There is no requirement to do anything else. I mean, what are the changes in the rewards? I would say that you could eventually change miner payouts to use EIP-1559 style transactions instead, but you don't _have_ to do that let's move this over to <#692078615269212180> btw, this is more for core devs Oh ok thank you perema! this is super cool Miners need to double their target gas limit at the fork block because with 1559 the target is for blocks to be 50% full. The gas limit automatically doubles when the fork activated but if the gas target isn’t changed it will gradually be voted back down effectively halving capacity. That’s for supporting the network But what about supporting the actual mining pool? Also lower gas limit means less uncles And a smaller AWS bill https://notes.ethereum.org/@barnabe/rk5ue1WF_ <:FeelsGoodMan:439871150269530113> wrong discord, for smaller blocks head over to bitcoin r&d Why won't 10x the gas limit then? or 100x? 100x the TPS

excerpts.author: rishabh42
excerpts.content:
Greetings everyone,
I'm interested to know what implications will the EIP-1559 update have on my currently deployed DApp on the mainnet?
Would any changes be required on the current UI? 

Would be grateful if anyone could help me on this 
Thanks in advance

excerpts.author: pietjepuk
excerpts.content: The bare minimum is to just upgrade your clients to a London fork supporting version. There is no requirement to do anything else.

excerpts.author: alexssd7fp
excerpts.content: I mean, what are the changes in the rewards?

excerpts.author: pietjepuk
excerpts.content: I would say that you could eventually change miner payouts to use EIP-1559 style transactions instead, but you don't _have_ to do that

excerpts.author: pietjepuk

excerpts.content: Oh ok

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: Miners need to double their target gas limit at the fork block because with 1559 the target is for blocks to be 50% full. The gas limit automatically doubles when the fork activated but if the gas target isn’t changed it will gradually be voted back down effectively halving capacity.

excerpts.author: alexssd7fp
